## What changed

- **Support for ERB templates (`.erb`).** Embedded Ruby templates now isolate `<% ... %>` and `<%= ... %>` code blocks while preserving exact line and column positions. Classes, methods, and functions defined within ERB templates are resolved via tree-sitter AST symbol extraction, and `<%# @lat:` / `# @lat:` comments are scanned as code references.
- **Merged upstream improvements.**
  - Crash-safe OS locks for search index writers (#169).
  - Single-file `search.db` publishing (#168).
  - Reindex crash fixes for duplicate and formatted headings (#167).
  - PHP source declaration extraction and code reference support (#165).
  - Local Turso section-aware hybrid search retrieval (#151) with evidence summaries and score breakdowns (#152).
  - Graph viewer navigation and Git diff styling fixes (#158, #159, #160, #161).

## Upgrading

```
mise use -g npm:@plebeiantech/lat.md@latest
```

```
npm i -g --prefix ~/.local/lat https://github.com/PlebeianTech/lat.md/releases/latest/download/lat.md-latest.tgz
```
